tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: The Home screen and wallpaper: what shows when no window is open. Never a busy image.

tokens.name: backdrop-glow
tokens.usage: Centre of the soft radial glow on the backdrop, fading to backdrop at the edges.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Window body, bottom of the card gradient. Text and controls sit here.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Top of the card gradient, raised layers: menus, toasts, taskbar. The command palette uses it fully opaque, never see-through.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Hover, pressed and selected rows; round icon buttons.

tokens.name: header
tokens.usage: The thin title strip at the top of every card window.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Full-height navigation sidebars (Explorer, Settings). Translucent over Mica or acrylic so the wallpaper glows through faintly. Text on it is ink or ink-muted at full strength.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px edge on every card, toast and bar. Gives the frosted lift without a heavy shadow.

tokens.name: glass-sheen
tokens.usage: Faint top highlight inside cards (inset 0 1px). Optional.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Full-screen dim behind the command palette so busy windows never fight its text. Fades in with the palette.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline under the title strip and between list sections. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and focus outlines on surface-100 and surface-200. 3:1 there.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: names, titles, body copy.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Title strip text, timestamps, paths, shortcut hints, ghost button labels at rest.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Used sparingly: caret, unread dot, focused input outline, progress. Never a fill behind text blocks.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Text selection and the selected row in Home search. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text or glyph on a solid accent fill (count badges).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive confirmations. On surface-100 or surface-200 only.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, connected, charging. State only.

tokens.name: tag-blue
tokens.usage: Label dot and label glyph for the Dev tools category. Only as a 6px dot or a 16px glyph next to ink-muted text, never as a fill behind text.

tokens.name: tag-green
tokens.usage: Label dot and label glyph for the Media category. Only as a 6px dot or a 16px glyph next to ink-muted text, never as a fill behind text.

tokens.name: tag-violet
tokens.usage: Label dot and label glyph for the Games category. Only as a 6px dot or a 16px glyph next to ink-muted text, never as a fill behind text.

tokens.name: tag-rose
tokens.usage: Label dot and label glyph for the Social category. Only as a 6px dot or a 16px glyph next to ink-muted text, never as a fill behind text.

tokens.name: tag-teal
tokens.usage: Label dot and label glyph for the System and utilities category. Only as a 6px dot or a 16px glyph next to ink-muted text, never as a fill behind text.

tokens.name: key
tokens.usage: Keyboard key chips (Esc, Enter, Alt+1). Paired with a 1px glass-edge and ink-muted mono text.

families.sans: "Inter", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: identifier
styles.usage: Item identifiers and aliases (CL, DL, LMS-142), always ink-muted, fixed-width column.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Snap gap between windows, row padding, gap between ghost buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Title strip vertical padding, toast padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Ghost button horizontal padding, list padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between content blocks inside a card.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Card body inset: content starts 40px in from the card edge.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Ghost buttons, rows, tabs, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Windows, toasts, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Home search field, command palette, taskbar.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Round icon buttons (the floating plus), unread dots.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Windows and toasts. Soft and wide, never a hard drop.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Command palette and Home search, always over the scrim.

tokens.name: strip-height
tokens.usage: Window title strip.

tokens.name: taskbar-height
tokens.usage: Floating taskbar.

tokens.name: icon-button
tokens.usage: Round icon buttons.

tokens.name: toast-width
tokens.usage: Toast notifications.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur on taskbar and toasts where the tool supports acrylic. Never on the command palette: it stays solid.

tokens.name: key-height
tokens.usage: Keyboard key chip height; min width the same so single keys are square.

tokens.name: launcher-width
tokens.usage: Launcher (Start and search) panel width.

tokens.name: app-tile
tokens.usage: App icon tile in the launcher's pinned grid; the icon inside is 24px.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fills.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Closing and dismissing anything: windows, toasts, palette, scrim out.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Opening windows and the palette, scrim in.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Toasts sliding in, Home search rising in.

tokens.name: duration-intro
tokens.usage: Whole sign-in intro, from backdrop to Home search ready.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between list rows appearing (palette results, recent items). Cap at 6 rows.

tokens.name: duration-merge
tokens.usage: A dropped window shrinking into its new tab, and a tab growing back out into a window.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Everything appearing: fast start, long soft settle.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Everything leaving: gentle start, quick finish.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Things moving on screen that neither enter nor leave (toast stack reflow, tab reorder).

tokens.name: rise
tokens.usage: How far a window, the palette or Home search travels up as it opens.

tokens.name: slide
tokens.usage: How far a toast travels in from the right edge.

tokens.name: scale-from
tokens.usage: Starting scale for opening windows and the palette. Never below 0.95.

tokens.name: merge-scale
tokens.usage: Scale of a dragged window while it hovers over another window's tab strip, signalling it will merge.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Compact density: list rows, sidebar items, palette results. Icons 16px, one line, smallest gaps.

tokens.name: row-comfy
tokens.usage: Comfy density (default): rows with 16px icons and a little air.

tokens.name: row-spacious
tokens.usage: Spacious density: 24px icons and a second line of detail (item count, dimensions, location).

tokens.name: icon-list
tokens.usage: Row icon size in compact and comfy.

tokens.name: icon-list-large
tokens.usage: Row icon size in spacious.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Explorer and Settings sidebar width.
